brief: The Claude Code stack a one-person founder uses to ship like a 10-person team. Each tool, what it does, why it matters.

slots.title: 1. GitHub, the repository
slots.body: Hosts code and runs CI/CD pipelines. Claude Code reads your entire repo context to write, test, and push features without breaking production.

slots.title: 2. Next.js, the framework
slots.body: Full-stack React with built-in routing and API routes. Claude Code generates pages, handlers, and middleware using your existing file patterns.

slots.title: 3. Supabase, the backend
slots.body: Postgres database, auth, and storage in one platform. Claude Code writes SQL migrations and row-level security policies from your schema.

slots.title: 4. Stripe, the billing
slots.body: Processes subscriptions and one-off charges securely. Claude Code builds checkout sessions and webhook endpoints using your live API keys.

slots.title: 5. Linear, the tracker
slots.body: Tracks bugs, features, and sprints with speed. Claude Code turns Linear issues into pull requests and updates ticket status on merge.

slots.title: 6. Figma, the canvas
slots.body: Designs interfaces and prototypes before coding starts. Claude Code inspects exported frames to generate matching Tailwind markup and component props.
